name: Maruzen CHI Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: Maruzen CHI Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the sale of books and magazines in Japan. It operates through Educational Market Sales; Store/Online Sales Business; Library Support; Publication; and Others segments. The company provides academic and other information services; and manages educational facilities, such as libraries. It also engages in design, supervision, and construction works; and publishing books and magazines.
